implemented_shadow_only: Versioned terminal precedence with rollback over simultaneous standby.
Rollback/standby resolution occurs before nonessential telemetry parsing.
N/R terminal residence round-trips as canonical current-control-state and fails closed without authenticated exit authority.
Risk input is explicit typed string; None/non-string cannot alias to NONE.
EventKind has one canonical typed parser in the shadow path.
EventIdentity rejects None/non-string coercion and uses bounded canonical token syntax.
Raw verified claim has zero shadow credit without matching event-bound C/independent-verifier receipt and C_VERIFIED stage.
DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only and have zero shadow operational credit without event-bound durable artifact receipt.
v1 guard_status/return_condition and v2 checkpoint/ACK/verification metadata are projected into the shadow decision.
Caller-declared secretary freshness/authority-conflict and shift/progress ratios have no shadow routing authority until evidence-bound envelopes/ledger exist.

Durable atomic shadow replay registry consumes identity only after acceptance; exact replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding conflicts; same lineage/new-ID is duplicate; rejected claims do not reserve identity.
Irrelevant verifier metadata is not parsed for zero/operational event classes.
Ledger outcome accounting is explicit and testable rather than silently dropping rejected verified claims.
self_review_repairs_in_same_round: Fixed initial shadow bug where malformed lower-priority standby could suppress rollback despite rollback-over-standby policy.
Fixed initial receipt-binding gap by adding decision event_id and requiring receipt.event_id to match the decision event identity.
Disabled untrusted secretary/shift metrics from shadow routing instead of forwarding caller declarations as authority.

coverage: rollback survival under malformed lower-priority standby and telemetry
